provenance.prompt: Create an original transparent RGBA sprite sheet of exactly six complete full-body drawings of Reed Ashcroft, Chicago Condas support athlete cell 0. Use attached portrait and gameplay references as strict character identity references and the clean Reed standard-pass atlas for pixel-art scale and style only. Preserve medium-brown skin, dark eyes and brows, small dark goatee, dark-purple and black braids swept into a high topknot, natural young-adult human athletic proportions, and purple-and-gold basketball uniform with white lower-leg wear and matching shoes. No glasses, gray beard, wooden crest, cape, scarf, armor, animal traits, extra jewelry, or fantasy props. Right-facing three-quarter full-body view in every drawing, same scale and camera as the reference atlas. Arrange exactly six different poses in a 3-column by 2-row sheet, strict row-major order. Each figure wholly visible and isolated on transparency, with broad clear transparent padding around each figure and broad gutters between figures; no limb crosses another cell and no clipping, touching, overlap, or fusion. Hands remain empty: no basketball, ball, shadow, or held object. No ground, cast shadow, glow, text, numbers, logos, checkerboard, panel, border, grid lines, extra figures, or duplicate poses. Pose sequence: 0 balanced ready stance, hands open near waist; 1 bend knees and bring both empty hands together in front of upper chest; 2 lift hands above forehead, elbows bent outward, loading an overhead pass; 3 step forward and extend both arms fully above head in a clear overhead pass release with wrists finishing forward; this is the release pose; 4 distinct high follow-through with extended hands and weight over lead foot; 5 recover to balanced ready stance. Keep face, hair, skin, build, clothing and scale consistent.
